scope: Nemo certe ignorat Latin only; one historical citation note on printed p.353/canvas363; source bytes outside the declared half-open parent range remain exact.
models_license: Apache-2.0; exact upstream LICENSE and README.md retained in models.zip
preprocessing: Exact native JPEG input; lossless crop to PNG, Gray colorspace,8-bit depth; compare unthresholded grayscale with35%/40% threshold; density300; strip only output PNG metadata. Never OCR a viewing proxy.
selection_basis: Compare actual unthresholded crop with raw outputs; English40% PSM6 and7 each preserve material note address and cited chapter. No expected source words enter recognition commands, configuration or composition.

composition.replacement_rule: Read selected raw TXT, strip only leading/trailing whitespace, splice by exact half-open byte offsets. No source characters are typed or reconstructed.
